text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a day out, I stop by a shop with Agnes Digital to pick up something she preordered.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting forever for this photo book… Oohoohoo, I'm duty-bound to open it as soon as I get home!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That's because I bought three copies. One for careful perusal, one for posterity, and one for daily use!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Also, each copy comes with a special raffle entry for an upcoming release event. Since I bought three copies, I've tripled my chances of being select—

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that Digital? No way! What a coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Uh… Oh! Hello! I haven't seen you since that handout event!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're stopped by a woman inside of the shop. It seems likely she's a fellow Umamusume fan.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: I know this is a bit sudden, but you don't happen to be free after this, are you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Well, ummm…

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: I'm planning to go to a concert right after this, but the friend I was supposed to go with can't make it.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: I don't want to leave an empty seat, so I thought I should find someone else to go.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Right after this? T-that would mean… wait, you're talking about the secret concert tied to that one album!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The "Phantom Secret" concert, right?! I bought sooo many copies of the album, but none of them contained any tickets!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I convinced myself there was no way to go to a super-duper premium deluxe concert like that and gave up… and yet, here you are, an actual godsend, inviting me to go!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I've actually got two tickets, so you can bring your friend, too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I would absolutely love to go! Gyaaaagh! Thank you so so muuuch!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, yay! I just know that you'll liven things up!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You bet! I'll put everything I've got into it! I even have my light sticks on me already!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: Does your friend have anything to bring? We're allowed to take in our own support merch for the event.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell them I don't have any light sticks or anything, so they both graciously offer to lend me something.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Do you want a light stick or a paper fan?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll let you borrow mine! Now, let's head to the amusement park's special venue space!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh. My. Gooooosh! She winked at me! I must have died and gone to heaven by this merciless assault of fanservice!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: …Wait, what's this?! No way! Is this a new song?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All the light sticks in the crowd change colors in time with the music. I do my best to change the color of mine too, but I panic and fail to make it in time.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, Trainer! There's a setting to change the color automatically. Push the button on the right!
choice_data_list: But I've got the wrong color…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: There's no wrong way to enjoy a concert! Just respect the rules and have good manners.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Let the music carry you and pick whatever color you like!
choice_data_list: Okay, I'll try just feeling it.
Okay, I'll try just feeling it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit! Remember to have fun!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh maaaaan… That was… the best. Seriously, like the best of the very best…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Did you notice her grip during the first song?! I've never wanted to be a mic stand so badly!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And I liked how intense the dance for the new song is! Their steps were so powerful, super fitting for Umamusume. The choreographer really knows what they're doing!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Everyone's heel clicks were all timed so perfectly! You could really feel how in sync they were!
choice_data_list: I liked when we waved the lights together.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Definitely! Isn't waving the light stick fun?
choice_data_list: It felt like the whole venue came together as one.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yes! That's exactly it! When the chorus and the lights all synced up, it's like we were all unified! That's the true beauty of concerts!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's so great that I can talk about this with you! The other times, I'm always alone, so I can only fire off my feelings into the Umatterverse.
choice_data_list: Moments like this after the concert are fun too, yeah?
Moments like this after the concert are fun too, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You totally get it! All right, then… I've got an idea! I'm gonna apply for two tickets to the release event tied to the photo books I bought today.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: If I win tickets, let's go together! And then we can talk all about it after! Okay?!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: You can use the fan my friend was going to use! Okay, shall we head to the venue over at the amusement park?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: More! Love! Straight to! My heart!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The call and response echoes throughout the entire event space. The thrill of the crowd reaches a fever pitch, and Agnes Digital goes wild along with everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, the Umamusume on stage walks in our direction as she sings.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Trainer, your fan! Your fan! Show her the fan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I do as I'm told and fix the way I'm holding the fan so the words are facing the stage.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ohmigaaaaagfhksgh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I saw them! She really spun and showed them to us! Pant, pant. That. Was. Too. CUTE! The way she lifted her leg?! The way her skirt fluttered?! Absolutely… DIVINE!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaagh! A real angel came down from heaven!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Thanks for allowing me that sip, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's 'cause of the fan! The fan! Thanks to that, she gave you a big glass of fanservice, and I got a sip too!
choice_data_list: Oh yeah. That was pretty nice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume on the stage saw our message and reacted to it. Even if it was only for a split second, it felt like we were communicating.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Right? And it's not just the fanservice. Once you get a taste of the concert atmosphere, it makes you wanna do it again and again.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I think I know what you mean.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Heheh, live concerts have got you hooked now, yeah? Congrats, welcome to the ocean of Uma simping! ☆

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I've got an idea! I'm gonna apply for two tickets to the release event tied to the photo books I bought today.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Let's go to another concert together! We'll dive deeper and deeper till we're drowning in Uma glory!
